chunks: With this chain of transmission, from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), he said:

Verily, for Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, are angels; nothing from the layers of their bodies is not glorifying Allah, the Mighty and High, and praising Him from one side with different voices. They do not lift their heads to the sky, nor lower them to their feet, from weeping and awe of Allah, the Mighty and High.

key_terms.أَطْبَاقِ أَجْسَادِهِمْ: layers or strata of their bodies

ai.seo_question: What is the physical state and spiritual condition of the angels who constantly glorify Allah?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq highlights this unique angelic state to illustrate the perfection of divine worship, where physical form and spiritual consciousness are entirely unified in submission. This description serves as a model for believers, emphasizing that true reverence (khushu) involves a balanced humility—neither arrogant nor despondent—while maintaining constant awareness of Allah's majesty. The hadith underscores the Shia emphasis on the continuous, active glorification of the celestial beings as a reflection of the cosmic order.
